# BluePeak HVAC AI

> AI-guided diagnostics for HVAC technicians. Describe a symptom or upload an OEM service manual and get ranked, cited hypotheses and field tests, each backed by the exact page of the manual it came from.

BluePeak is an early-access product built by a solo developer, not a company. There is no self-serve signup yet -- access is granted by email. No pricing has been set; usage is free during this stage.

- [Home](https://bluepeakhvac.net/): what BluePeak does, how it works, scope and limitations
- [About](https://bluepeakhvac.net/about.html): who built it and why
